Messages.Author: Andreas Nusser
Messages.Body:
I just happened to see some new artwork of the Anarch cards and I
noticed (this may sound a little pre mature but heck I don't care) that
one of the new card is censored. The artwork shows some female
characters with !!censored!! breasts.

What the heck has happened! I mean VTES is made for adults not little
pokemon children. I don't want to have censored cards. Is there a
requirement on censoring intimate parts?

But why did WW begin to censor cards. They didn't do it in the past.
Just look the Sabbat cards. Up Yours, Demonstration and Sacrament of
Carnage and these cards haven't been censored.

Please no more censored cards.

Thanks

--
Andreas Nusser
www.vekn.de
a.nu...@vekn.de

parody that.

-Robert
